name: io.github.groove79/mcp-toss-payments
description: Toss Payments MCP: payment lookup, approval-gated cancel/refund, settlements. 토스페이먼츠 MCP.
title: Toss Payments

environmentVariables.name: TOSS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret key (test_sk_… or live_sk_…) from the Toss Payments developer center

environmentVariables.name: OKAGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OK Agent key (free at okagent.kr) — writes then wait for your OK on KakaoTalk. Unset: writes ask for confirmation in the chat first.

environmentVariables.name: KMCP_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: approval | confirm | direct (default: approval if OKAGENT_API_KEY is set, else confirm)
